encounter.title: Act I Encounter 4 — Square Candidate A (6x6 seed 78)
encounter.notes: LD-004 candidate A for Act I #4. 6x6 seed 78 (10 arrows: N1 E1 S5 W3). Introduces Stone Throw in isolation. Pattern: BOTTLENECK. Initial free West is 0. Key bottleneck: South arrow #7 must be removed on turn 1 to unlock West arrows #6 and #8. On turn 3, Stone Throw pins North #0 safely, leaving #8(W) free to hit. Clean sequence: #7(S) -> #6(W) -> #8(W) -> #9(W) (4 taps, 0 damage). Blundering by tapping wrong arrows delays West access and causes Thrower to attack for 2 damage.
